items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: I said, now listen, Sergeant Norbert. If that's going to do you any good to change the route of the parade... I said, take it over because I've been ill now.

ctx.x: Third year you had the king.

The king. So now when we had the king, we already had the queen. So we weren't going to put the queen behind the king. And it's a ladies organization. And we had her first. Why put the man first and we've already had the... You understand what I mean? I thought there was something to it that we should honor and keep it. And so I told him that. Oh, it doesn't matter. It doesn't matter. A king is always ahead of the queen. I said, now listen, Sergeant Norbert. If that's going to do you any good to change the route…

Uh, what was the cause of the Holy Family? To be in the back there. Well, because that's the way they were stationed. That's what I, I, you didn't know I was worried. I was worried. You didn't know. I know, but they were on a station there until college. They'd play some over here, some there, some in college. I was worried about that. I wouldn't even. As they'd call them out, they'd come and take their place. As they'd call them out.
